elaine: quick FYI — nightly longseq run at ~02:14 showed a sharp tail-latency spike. attached nsys trace and perfetto link. HBM BW spiked and KV cache miss rate jumped. https://perfetto.app/trace/abc123

sam: taking a look. at the moment in the trace I see a kernel selector switch right before the spike (kernel: matmul_heavy instead of qpath_matmul). can you upload the nsys summary?

ryan: fyi repro steps I used: 
```./run_infer --seq 4096 --batch 8 --trace nsys --seed 42```
that reliably reproduces the tail spike locally. NV kernel timeline shows big memcpy+launch pattern.

sam: hmm batch=8 with seq=4096 seems large — our batching heuristic is supposed to avoid combining many longseqs. did any PR touch thresholds recently? (PR #3021 changed the packer).

elaine: good catch. I opened the trace in nsight and the selector chose the dense kernel path. will grep commits since last good run. perf-bot posted an alert:

perf-bot: perf-alert: job=nightly-longseq, baseline=2026-03-10, current=2026-03-17, p99 +28%, HBM avg BW +42%, KV miss rate +15%

ryan: nvprof slice shows DMA bursts (nvlink) at the exact microburst windows. suspect KV prefetch logic was disabled due to coalesce optimization — config shows `prefetch.enabled=false` for longseq corner in the canary runtime. turning it back on locally removes the thrash.

sam: that lines up. PR #3021 relaxed the "coalesce_threshold" in packer when it saw small queues — that could cause multiple long sequences to be packed and evict KV pages. can you test reverting the prefetch toggle in staging?

elaine: deploying a quick revert to staging now. rollout id r_20260317_prefetch_revert. will run the same nsys profile and post perfetto link when done.

ryan: after revert, HBM BW spikes are gone on my staging run. p95 and p99 are back within ~5% of baseline; throughput dip is ~3%. tradeoff seems acceptable for now.

sam: nice. next steps: tighten batching heuristics so >4 longseqs aren't packed together, and add a guard in kernel selector to prefer qpath for seq>=2048 unless memory headroom confirmed. I'll open an issue and add unit tests for packer.

elaine: created issue #3129: "longseq microbatching + prefetch toggle causes KV thrash". attached traces and nsys summaries, assigned to @sam and @ryan.

sam: I'll take the kernel selector test and the packer guard. @ryan can you own a small perf regression test to catch p99 regressions in nightly?

ryan: yep, I'll add a targeted regression test and embed a short synthetic nsys profile step.

elaine: thanks everyone. following traces and logs are in the issue. I'll keep watching staging for any regressions. :thumbsup:

sam: LGTM. keep an eye on the canary for 2 hours after deploy to prod.

ryan: noted. ty all.
